title: Virtual Lab: AI agents design nanobodies against SARS-CoV-2
summary: A group of AI agents led by a principal agent designed 92 nanobodies: two bound to spike protein from recent variants in lab tests, and humans wrote about 1% of the conversation. Only 2 of 92 bound; the date is the Nature publication date given on the page.

evidence.tested: The Virtual Lab designed 92 nanobodies; experiments (multiplexed ELISA) showed a range of functional binders. Two showed improved binding to JN.1 or KP.3 while keeping strong binding to the ancestral spike protein.
evidence.unknown: The two are called candidates for further investigation. Neutralization and clinical use not reported in the abstract. Full text is paywalled; counts of tested designs beyond 92 and binding values were not read.
evidence.ai_role: An LLM principal investigator agent guided LLM scientist agents through meetings, with human feedback; they built a pipeline using ESM, AlphaFold-Multimer and Rosetta. Humans ran the experiments.
